cohort: 335 women aged 40 years and older with a history of cesarean delivery who never delivered vaginally, who delivered at a single hospital in Israel between 2006 and 2017
finding: In women aged 40 years and older with a history of cesarean delivery who never delivered vaginally, previous cesarean delivery due to dysfunctional labor and a higher inter-delivery birthweight difference were independently associated with failed trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
